scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
scripts.docker:rebuild: npm ci && npm run docker:build && docker compose --env-file .env.local -f compose.yaml up --detach --wait --wait-timeout 120
scripts.docker:logs: docker compose --env-file .env.local -f compose.yaml logs --follow api db
scripts.docker:check: docker compose --env-file .env.local -f compose.yaml --profile tools run --build --rm tools
scripts.docker:logs:production: docker compose --env-file .env.production -f compose.production.yaml logs --follow api db
scripts.docker:build: docker compose --env-file .env.local -f compose.yaml --profile tools build api tools
